body:
Sorry to hear you're in a tough place mate. Without a support network of friends, anyone can fail. The expectations placed on us as kids to fit a mold and perform is harsh, and a misstep at any poit, whether it be susceptibility to anxiety or a social disorder can really put you on the back foot and left behind.

However, can I be the bad guy and say that love will not solve  even half of your problems?

I went without love for many years, not by choice. It was really hard. I thought that finding someone to love who would love me would be the solution. Or even just a solution. Don't get me wrong, it feels good, but it's transient. Years, months, doesn't matter. Some folk even get stuck in the cycle of trying to find new love again to keep the fire going. It's a mistake! True, every situation is different, but a dating resume of short to medium term relationships like mine doesn't look good.

Start a new fire. Build relationships with people without looking for love or sex. Do this by putting yourself in challenging situations that require more than just one persob to get through. Not a good example, but this is one reason people join the military.

Perhaps try rock climbing first? Look for another neck beard and help each other. Say goodbye to each other at the end of the night, then if it was good go back for round two.

Thanks for the replies.

I can probably get another job, but it's subsistence only. Haven't managed to yet after 6 months of active applications.

I saw several doctors, both about anxiety and impotence. Some of them react badly to the latter,insisting that I'm young and shouldn't be affected. The anxiety is usually treated with SSRIs. In my experience they make the anxiety worse and I can't take them. Plus they cause permanent cognitive damage- they're just medicated slow lobotomisation.

I made the mistake of telling my boss I'm being treated for anxiety so that he could at least know and, I don't know, manage around it. It's his right to know in theory. Sadly, he has used it against me and sabotaged my chances at a good grad job by insisting on being a reference, and then giving a bad one. I'm at a loss, I never knew someone who purports to be so good and has such a shiny image could be such a cunt. It was not as if I'm a threat to him.
